Time series analysis

Retail Sales Forecasting .

Exploring weekly sales patterns and building a 30-day forecast from retail transactions.

Daily sales · USD millions
View Repository

Project context

Data Inventory Analysis · IS388

  • Python
  • pandas
  • SARIMA

Research question

How do retail sales vary from day to day, and can their weekly pattern help forecast the next month? The transaction records include dates, products, package sizes, quantities, and sales values.

My contribution

For my individual model, I tested the daily sales series for stationarity, differenced it, and fitted a SARIMA model with a seven-day seasonal period. I produced a 30-day forecast with 95% prediction intervals.

From transactions to a time series

The notebook standardises product sizes and sums transaction values by date. It compares daily and monthly trends, identifies top-selling products, and explores a second forecasting approach using Prophet.

Interpreting the results

The SARIMA model had an in-sample R² of 0.7208. Measuring forecast accuracy would require testing on a later period. The chart shows daily totals from the supplied January 2016 transactions. The notebook reports experiments using a longer period in 2016.
